content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIM Rohtak Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 29-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in IIM Rohtak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for Various Administrative Posts in IIM Rohtak Recruitment 2026, including Chief Manager, Hindi Officer, Deputy Manager, Accountant, and Assistant Manager.

faq.question: Q2. What are the application modes for IIM Rohtak Various Administrative Posts?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for the IIM Rohtak Various Administrative Posts by sending their complete application along with required documents via Email. The application mode is entirely offline through email submission.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIM Rohtak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the email application for IIM Rohtak Recruitment 2026 is 29 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: The required qualifications vary by post, including Post Graduation, Master's degree in Hindi/English, Degree in Commerce, and B.E/B.Tech CS/IT or MBA, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for IIM Rohtak Various Administrative Posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIM Rohtak Various Administrative Posts recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for Chief Manager post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Chief Manager post is Pay Level-12, which ranges from Rs.78800 to Rs.209200, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIM Rohtak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for IIM Rohtak Recruitment 2026 includes a Written Test followed by Document Verification. Candidates must clear both stages for final selection.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for IIM Rohtak posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Various Administrative Posts is Rohtak, Haryana, with Pincode 124010, as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIM Rohtak?
faq.answer: The official website for Indian Institute of Management Rohtak is https://www.iimrohtak.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and updates.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is available. SC/ST candidates receive 5 years relaxation, while PWD/Ex-Servicemen get relaxation as per Government of India norms. Internal candidates also receive relaxation based on their service period.
